data.name: Biochar Energy Sustainable Technologies
data.description: Biochar Energy Sustainable Technologies (BEST) is a US-based biochar producer that uses pyrolysis to convert biomass into biochar, marketed under the OptiBiomass and Pyroltix/Pyrolytix AI brands. The company positions itself around biomass-to-biochar pyrolysis and the market for high-quality biochar and certified carbon credits. It is a small-team operation (around 3 employees per LinkedIn) targeting both soil/agriculture and voluntary CDR markets.
